about: Size fixtures, run by tools/ci/test-hygiene.ps1 against tools/ci/hygiene.json. entries: path, size in bytes, optional type (blob or commit). 'repeat' expands an entry n times with -<i> before the extension.

cases.name: small-tree
cases.why: positive control: ordinary source files pass

cases.name: large-source-file
cases.why: outside goldens/, a file is at most 1 MiB
match: ^src/Lrm\.Gpu\.Vulkan\.Interop/Vk\.g\.fs is 1\.50 MiB \(1572864 bytes\), over the 1\.00 MiB limit: the default per-file limit$

cases.name: golden-under-limit
cases.why: positive control: a golden file may be up to 2 MiB

cases.name: golden-over-limit
cases.why: GoldenSet: a committed golden file is at most 2 MiB
match: ^goldens/tiny/g2/fwd_f64p\.safetensors is 2\.00 MiB \(2097153 bytes\), over the 2\.00 MiB limit: GoldenSet

cases.name: tiny-budget
cases.why: O1 acceptance: goldens/tiny is at most 5 MiB in total
match: ^files under goldens/tiny/\*\* total 5\.72 MiB \(6000000 bytes\), over the 5\.00 MiB budget

cases.name: qwen-budget
cases.why: G2 acceptance: committed Qwen goldens are at most 10 MiB
match: ^files under goldens/qwen3-0\.6b/\*\* total 11\.44 MiB \(12000000 bytes\), over the 10\.00 MiB budget

cases.name: tree-budget
cases.why: the whole tree stays under 64 MiB
match: ^files under \*\* total 66\.76 MiB \(70000000 bytes\), over the 64\.00 MiB budget

cases.name: weights-outside-goldens
match: ^models/Qwen3-0\.6B/model\.safetensors must not be committed: weights live in LRM_DATA/models

cases.name: registry-and-headers
cases.why: vk.xml and SDK headers live in LRM_DATA/toolchain

cases.name: build-output
cases.why: artifacts/, bin/, obj/ and binaries are never committed
match: ^artifacts/bin/Lrm\.Core/release/Lrm\.Core\.dll must not be committed: build output

cases.name: agent-allowlist
cases.why: AgentPermissions: AP-0 was declined, so .claude/settings.json is never committed

cases.name: run-log
cases.why: run logs live in LRM_DATA/runs; test fixtures under tests/ are allowed
match: ^docs/reports/inference/events\.n0\.jsonl must not be committed: run logs
